name: Garlic Butter Rice
summary: Mild garlic butter rice made with separately cooked sona masuri rice, lightly golden garlic, spring onion, pepper and optional herbs.

items.preparation: washed 2–3 times, soaked for 20 minutes, fully drained and air-dried in a strainer for 20–30 minutes
adjust to taste; add more only if genuinely needed after cooking

ingredients.section: Optional Extra Garlic Chips — Use-Up Option

items.preparation: thinly sliced; optional fixed use-up amount
for frying the optional garlic chips

preparation.after: Wash 2–3 times, soak for 20 minutes, drain fully and air-dry in a strainer for 20–30 minutes.
Keep the whites and greens separate because they are added at different stages.

preparation.lead: For the optional garlic chips, thinly slice:
preparation.after: Keep the slices reasonably even so they brown at the same rate. Skip this step when not using the extra-garlic option.

cookingMethod.text: Build pressure on the induction cooker.
Reduce to 300 W at 100°C and cook until the rice is slightly firm and suitable for later tossing. Keep the exact low-power duration as a testing note until the repeat trial confirms it.
Open, fluff gently, spread on a wide plate and cool before tossing.

cookingMethod.lead: For the optional garlic chips, heat in a small pan over low-medium heat:
cookingMethod.after: Skip this and the next chip steps when not using the optional extra garlic.
Fry slowly, stirring frequently, until the slices become pale golden.

cookingMethod.text: Remove the garlic chips immediately to a plate or absorbent paper. Do not wait for them to become dark brown because they continue colouring after removal and may turn bitter.

cookingMethod.after: Cook only until aromatic and lightly golden.

cookingMethod.lead: Add the cooled rice and toss gently:
cookingMethod.after: Use medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes without breaking the grains. Taste and add more salt only if genuinely needed.

cookingMethod.lead: Switch off the heat and finish with:

cookingMethod.text: Optional finish: sprinkle the prepared garlic chips over the Garlic Butter Rice, or divide them between the rice and Mushroom Vegetable Pepper Gravy while serving.

servingSuggestions: Serve with Mushroom Vegetable Pepper Gravy as a tested meal combination.
notes: This is not a One Pot rice recipe because the rice is cooked separately, cooled and tossed.
Cooling the rice before tossing reduces sticking and breakage.
Draining and briefly air-drying soaked sona masuri rice helps produce firmer, more separated grains.
Keep garlic lightly golden; dark garlic may become bitter.
Keep the seasoning mild because the vegetable gravy is the stronger component.
Recipe remains in Testing status until the repeat trial confirms the rice water and induction duration.
The standard Garlic Butter Rice garlic remains 20 g at 1× and scales normally.
At 1.25×, the standard rice recipe uses 25 g garlic.
The optional extra 30 g garlic-chip amount is fixed and does not scale.
The optional chips are intended for using leftover peeled garlic without making the main rice excessively garlicky.
Do not add the entire optional 30 g directly to the Garlic Butter Toss.
Keep the optional garlic chips pale golden because dark garlic becomes bitter.

Use-up example: Mushroom Vegetable Pepper Gravy at 1× uses 45 g garlic, Garlic Butter Rice at 1.25× uses 25 g garlic, and the optional chips use the remaining 30 g from a total of 100 g peeled garlic.
